name: io.github.purinzan/gx3-cli-mcp
title: GX Works3 Project Analysis
description: Read-only analysis of Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC PLC projects saved by GX Works3 (.gx3): trace why a coil never turns on, find where a device is written and read, search by device comment, and separate conditions arriving from physical inputs, HMI or network communication. Runs locally and never modifies the project.
